title: outbox_worker panic kills delivery silently with no restart
description: outbox_worker() (kith-peer/src/lib.rs:1372) runs forever as a tokio task. If any code it calls panics (e.g., a store operation, the serializer, or a future poll), the task aborts and the JoinHandle yields JoinError. If the caller discards the handle (likely with tokio::spawn), the outbox dies silently: no more messages are ever delivered, no log at ERROR level, no restart. Fix: catch panics via tokio::task::spawn + JoinHandle, or use a supervision loop.
